de.title: DoorStateService V2.1: DoorOpenState ist in der PDF mit OperationState-Semantik beschrieben

en.title: DoorStateService V2.1: DoorOpenState is described with OperationState semantics in the PDF
en.short: The RetrieveSpecificDoorOpenState response success row incorrectly describes a door operation state instead of the door open state.
en.long: The official V2.1 PDF describes the DoorOpenState success row in RetrieveSpecificDoorOpenStateResponse as the current door operation state. The exact XSD clearly separates the models: SpecificDoorOpenStateStructure contains OpenState, while SpecificDoorOperationStateStructure separately contains OperationState. The wording is therefore a confirmed copy/paste documentation defect rather than a shared data model.
en.recommendation: Do not derive XML or runtime rules from this description text. Use the separate official OpenState and OperationState XSD models for structure and validation.
